n1: It's nine fourteen at night. A furnace just quit, and the homeowner is calling your shop.
n2: The call gets answered right away, in your shop's name. No voicemail.
n3: First, it checks for danger. If there is a gas smell or a carbon monoxide alarm, it tells them to get out and call nine one one.
n4: Then it takes the name, the number and the address, one question at a time, and reads the number back.
n5: It offers real openings from your calendar. It never makes up a time.
n6: Booked. The job is on your calendar before the caller hangs up.
n7: Every job is tagged with where it came from, and what it is worth.
n8: Urgent. After hours. New customer. Your dispatcher sees it all at a glance.
n9: The customer gets a confirmation text, and a review request is lined up for when the job is done.
n10: Mark the job complete, and the review request goes out on its own.
n11: Next morning, another call. A twenty two year old furnace, and the owner wants a price.
n12: It books the estimate visit, and puts the install in your pipeline.
n13: If that estimate goes quiet, follow ups go out on day two, day seven, and day fourteen.
n14: When the install closes, it moves to won.
n15: And it counts toward the fifteen thousand dollars in booked jobs we guarantee in your first ninety days.
n16: Aurelium Front Office for H V A C. Every call answered. Every job booked. Every estimate followed up. Want to hear it answer as your shop? Book thirty minutes with Juan, at Aurelium Motion.
